name: Conditioning morph samplers (interpolate prompts with locked noise)
plain: ExplorerConditioningSampler renders a batch along a path between two or three positive prompts (A→B→C, optionally looping), combining them as a weighted token concat whose weights follow a curve. Every batch item gets the same initial noise (batch_index forced to 0) and, for stochastic samplers, the same per-step noise via a custom noise_sampler that repeats one draw across the batch, so only the conditioning changes. VideoInterpolateSampler morphs two latent clips over an overlap: each frame lerps the latents and the text embeddings by t, optionally blends 10% of the previous output, and re-denoises with a denoise that ramps up and down at the overlap edges.
math:
Symbols: t morph position; c_A, c_B conditionings; z_A, z_B latents.
Explorer: cond_i = concat(w_A(i)·c_A, w_B(i)·c_B, w_C(i)·c_C); noise_i = ε (shared); per-step noise shared across batch.
Interpolate: z = (1−t)z_A + t z_B (+0.1 previous); c = (1−t)c_A + t c_B; z' = KSampler(z, c, denoise = base·edge(t)).

props.extra_model_calls: one sampling per frame (interpolate) or per batch chunk (explorer)
props.params: Explorer: positive_a/b/c start and end strengths, curve_type, loop, batch_size, seed, steps, denoise; Interpolate: steps, cfg, feedback_mode, wave_config
